subject: Implement SchemaService for Layer 1 database operations
description:
Create `src/mamba_mcp_sap_hana/database/schema.py` with async service methods querying HANA `SYS.*` system views for schema discovery.

Methods to implement:
- `async def list_schemas(pool, include_system: bool) -> list[SchemaInfo]`
  - Queries `SYS.SCHEMAS` joined with table counts
  - Filters `_SYS_*`, `SYS`, `SYSTEM` unless `include_system=True`
- `async def list_tables(pool, schema_name, include_views, name_pattern) -> list[TableInfo]`
  - Queries `SYS.TABLES` for tables; optionally `SYS.VIEWS` for views
  - `name_pattern` applied via SQL LIKE
  - Validates schema existence, returns fuzzy suggestions if not found
- `async def describe_table(pool, table_name, schema_name, include_indexes, include_constraints) -> DescribeTableOutput`
  - Queries `SYS.TABLE_COLUMNS` (or `SYS.VIEW_COLUMNS` for views)
  - Optionally queries `SYS.INDEXES` + `SYS.INDEX_COLUMNS`
  - Optionally queries `SYS.CONSTRAINTS`
  - Validates table/view existence first
- `async def get_sample_rows(pool, table_name, schema_name, limit, columns, where_clause, randomize) -> SampleRowsOutput`
  - Builds SELECT with optional column filter, WHERE clause, LIMIT
  - Reports total row count alongside sample
  - Validates column names if specified

All methods use `asyncio.to_thread()` for hdbcli calls and return Pydantic models.

**Acceptance Criteria:**

_Functional:_
- [ ] `list_schemas` returns schemas with table counts, filters system by default
- [ ] `list_tables` queries both tables and views when requested
- [ ] `describe_table` handles both tables and views (VIEW_COLUMNS for views)
- [ ] `get_sample_rows` supports column selection, WHERE, and randomization
- [ ] All methods use asyncio.to_thread() for non-blocking execution

_Edge Cases:_
- [ ] Schema not found: returns error with fuzzy suggestions
- [ ] Table not found: returns error with fuzzy suggestions
- [ ] View instead of table: describe_table skips indexes/constraints
- [ ] Empty table: get_sample_rows returns row_count=0 with note
- [ ] Wide table (100+ columns): returns all columns with width warning

_Error Handling:_
- [ ] Permission denied: returns PERMISSION_DENIED error with grant guidance
- [ ] Invalid column in get_sample_rows: returns COLUMN_NOT_FOUND with suggestions

**Testing Requirements:**
• Unit: Each service method with mocked cursor returning expected rows
• Unit: System schema filtering logic
• Unit: Fuzzy matching integration for name suggestions
• Unit: View detection and VIEW_COLUMNS fallback

Source: internal/specs/mamba-mcp-hana-SPEC.md Section 5.1, 9.2, 13.2
